They set a budget of approximately $400,000–$500,000, wanted quiet suburban streets, nearby shops, restaurants and parks, at least two bedrooms and two bathrooms, and a workable commute to the city center. Oakwood Heights, Sunnybrook, Ridgewood, and Creekside were suggested, but the city was never identified, so neighborhood, school, and commute details remained generic and unverified. The user thought Oakwood Heights and Sunnybrook appeared to have the strongest schools, while planning to weigh commute, neighborhood character, and affordability and research further. All documented steps occurred on 2023-11-04; the planned move was about six months ahead, with no later outcome recorded.

On 2023-11-04, the user considered using Asana to organize the proposal, planning a separate project with tasks for each section, smaller subtasks, and priorities; no definite due date was set for finishing it. The proposal work preceded the planning discussion by two days; no later project status was recorded.
